title: Hauser Dynamics MK-IV Wideband Barycentric DX Correlator — Fast-Paced 3-Act Console Tour

steps.symbolic: ACT I • CONSOLE OVERVIEW & EXPANDABLE BAYS
steps.say: [sfx:point] Here is the Hauser Mark Four—four core bays, each with an expandable theater display.
steps.caption: Here is the Hauser Mark Four—four core bays, each with an expandable theater display.

steps.symbolic: BAY 1 • WIDEBAND TUNER & 4-MODE SPECTRUM MAPS
steps.say: [sfx:segment] Top bay: the Wideband Tuner scans six wavebands, four frequency maps, and expands full screen.
steps.caption: Top bay: the Wideband Tuner scans six wavebands, four frequency maps, and expands full screen.

steps.symbolic: BAY 2 • VISUAL, PHASE & CIPHER CORRELATOR
steps.say: [sfx:circle] Left bay: the Correlator decodes live cameras, phase plots, and cipher cartridges, then pops open.
steps.caption: Left bay: the Correlator decodes live cameras, phase plots, and cipher cartridges, then pops open.

steps.symbolic: BAY 3 • GALACTIC ASTROMETRY & SINPO MATRIX
steps.say: [sfx:intersect] Center bay: Galactic Astrometry slews our phased-array beam, grades SINPO merit, and opens the Atlas.
steps.caption: Center bay: Galactic Astrometry slews our phased-array beam, grades SINPO merit, and opens the Atlas.

steps.symbolic: BAY 4 • ROBOT-24 SSTV eQSL & DX MEMORY
steps.say: [sfx:concur] Right bay: the Verification Deck decodes slow-scan QSL cards and expands the hardware dossier.
steps.caption: Right bay: the Verification Deck decodes slow-scan QSL cards and expands the hardware dossier.

steps.symbolic: 6-CHANNEL PRESET BANK & WAVEBAND SELECTOR
steps.say: [sfx:point] Now let's operate the Tuner, jumping across ninety-meter cryo-scatter, octal relays, and hydrogen masers.
steps.caption: Now let's operate the Tuner, jumping across ninety-meter cryo-scatter, octal relays, and hydrogen masers.

steps.symbolic: SLIDING BAND-PLAN DIAL & CRYSTAL FILTER
steps.say: [sfx:ratio] Spinning the vernier wheel slides the illuminated callsign scale and narrows the crystal passband filter.
steps.caption: Spinning the vernier wheel slides the illuminated callsign scale and narrows the crystal passband filter.

steps.symbolic: 4-MODE FREQUENCY MAPS • WATERFALL TO DOPPLER I/Q
steps.say: [sfx:conjugate] Next door, the frequency map cycles between spectrogram waterfall, band allocation, three-D ridges, and Doppler phase.
steps.caption: Next door, the frequency map cycles between spectrogram waterfall, band allocation, three-D ridges, and Doppler phase.

steps.symbolic: EXPANDED WIDEBAND GALACTIC SPECTRUM SCANNER
steps.say: [sfx:concur] Expanding the Band-Plan Scanner displays all six wavebands alongside intermediate-frequency passband zoom and Doppler lock.
steps.caption: Expanding the Band-Plan Scanner displays all six wavebands alongside intermediate-frequency passband zoom and Doppler lock.

steps.symbolic: LIVE CAM-104 FEED & EXPANDED VISUAL THEATER
steps.say: [sfx:circle] In the Correlator Bay on Callisto, we lock live arc-camera video and expand the Visual Theater.
steps.caption: In the Correlator Bay on Callisto, we lock live arc-camera video and expand the Visual Theater.

steps.symbolic: 1420.406 MHz H-I MASER & 3:5 LISSAJOUS ROSE
steps.say: [sfx:ratio] Tuning the Triangulum beacon in Three-D Spectrum mode pairs the hydrogen maser spike with a Lissajous rose.
steps.caption: Tuning the Triangulum beacon in Three-D Spectrum mode pairs the hydrogen maser spike with a Lissajous rose.

steps.symbolic: CARTRIDGE MATRIX • ALG-01 FAULT → ALG-02 LOCK
steps.say: [sfx:intersect] On Trojan Octal frames, Algorithm One faults, while Algorithm Two locks and translates the Euclidean telemetry.
steps.caption: On Trojan Octal frames, Algorithm One faults, while Algorithm Two locks and translates the Euclidean telemetry.

steps.symbolic: EXPANDED CIPHER THEATER & SHORTWAVE ENVELOPE SCOPE
steps.say: [sfx:equal] We pop open the full Cipher Theater, then audition the voice intercept and interval signal on the scope.
steps.caption: We pop open the full Cipher Theater, then audition the voice intercept and interval signal on the scope.

steps.symbolic: PHASED-ARRAY BEAM SLEW & 20-SEGMENT SINPO MATRIX
steps.say: [sfx:segment] In the Center Bay, tuning slews our phased-array beam while the twenty-segment S-meter and SINPO matrix lock.
steps.caption: In the Center Bay, tuning slews our phased-array beam while the twenty-segment S-meter and SINPO matrix lock.

steps.symbolic: EXPANDED GALACTIC ASTROMETRY & CERES BASELINE ATLAS
steps.say: [sfx:concur] Expanding the Galactic Atlas reveals our Ceres Foundry parallax triangle, pulsar clock, and spiral-arm relay hops.
steps.caption: Expanding the Galactic Atlas reveals our Ceres Foundry parallax triangle, pulsar clock, and spiral-arm relay hops.

steps.symbolic: LIVE ROBOT-24 SSTV RASTER SCANLINE DECODE
steps.say: [sfx:circle] In the Right Bay, triggering a Robot-Twenty-Four slow-scan burst wipes down line by line to decode the QSL card.
steps.caption: In the Right Bay, triggering a Robot-Twenty-Four slow-scan burst wipes down line by line to decode the QSL card.

steps.symbolic: EXPANDED SSTV eQSL DOSSIER & DX MEMORY SLOTS
steps.say: [sfx:invariant] Expanding the QSL Dossier reveals the subcarrier clue, while the memory tabs below cycle verified operator logs.
steps.caption: Expanding the QSL Dossier reveals the subcarrier clue, while the memory tabs below cycle verified operator logs.

steps.symbolic: ACT III RECAP • 6-BAND TUNER & MULTI-MODE CORRELATOR
steps.say: [sfx:equal] In summary: the Mark Four pairs a six-band tuner and four-mode spectrum map with an expandable correlator.
steps.caption: In summary: the Mark Four pairs a six-band tuner and four-mode spectrum map with an expandable correlator.

steps.symbolic: ACT III RECAP • ASTROMETRY, SINPO & eQSL DOSSIERS
steps.say: [sfx:concur] And it unites galactic beam triangulation and SINPO grading with slow-scan e-QSL dossiers and full-screen modals.
steps.caption: And it unites galactic beam triangulation and SINPO grading with slow-scan e-QSL dossiers and full-screen modals.

steps.symbolic: 73 DE GOR-9 • ASTEROID 3-5-1 • HAUSER MK-IV READY
steps.say: [sfx:qed] Four bays, four expandable theaters, one complete deep-space DX workstation—seventy-three from Galactic Outpost Radio Nine.
steps.caption: Four bays, four expandable theaters, one complete deep-space DX workstation—seventy-three from Galactic Outpost Radio Nine.
